name: Lispr
description:
Free Mac Voice Dictation & Translation

Lispr turns your voice into text, anywhere on your Mac. It exists because we wanted it for ourselves — and couldn't find one this simple.

How Lispr Works:
✓ Push-to-Talk Gesture: Press and hold the right Option key to start recording your voice, and release it to drop typed text at your current cursor position.

✓ Live Translation: Tap an extra key mid-speech to translate your spoken words directly into one of 32 different target languages.

✓ No Accounts Needed: The utility requires no login, subscription, or setup configuration files to begin dictating.

✓ Privacy & Processing: Audio is processed via encrypted connections for transcription and is not stored or used for model training.
